claims.quote: A new species of the Indo-Burmese genus Badis was described in late 2011 from the Singen River, Brahmaputra basin in Arunachal Pradesh, India, raising the number of formally described species to sixteen.
The type series was collected from the Singen River, Saku-Kadu Village, East Siang District, Arunachal Brahmaputra drainage, north-eastern India.
